state.goal: Recover source-written pitches and relative intervals for Tipcha and Etnachta in the Levisson Shabbat Haftarah score, inspect associated tracks01-04, and preserve a reproducible witness-scoped result.
observed: Levisson publisher links a two-page scanned score from LJG siddur pages714-717 and lists separate Haftarah tracks01-04, attributed on the page to chazzan Avery Tracht.
First staff visually inspected in a high-resolution original-PDF render: treble clef, no key signature/accidentals; Mercha E4 G4, Tipcha G4 A4, Munach E4 A4, Etnachta E4 E4 E4 G4 B4 A4.
First Tipcha note to final Etnachta note gives written G4 to A4; both accent-final notes are A4. No score tuning reference or historical absolute waveform is supplied.
Publisher track01 caption says Mercha Tipcha Munach Etnachta, but its MP3 filename says Mercha Tipcha Mercha Etnachta. Preserve this conflict; filenames are not a listening transcript.

All four linked MP3s and the score were freshly downloaded and hashed. Existing Poppler renderer works. The initial host-Python fitz rendering attempt exited1 after retrieval; no source was lost. Existing parent-supplied miniaudio decoder can inspect recordings without new packages.
constraints: Do not transfer this witness's score pitches to Sinai Temple recordings or every tradition.
Written pitch names do not prescribe concert Hz, temperament, performed octave or one fixed note per accent.
Source-written motif, audio metadata, candidate acoustic contour and independently verified syllable alignment are different evidence levels.
Do not hide the track01 caption/filename discrepancy or use f0 to relabel the phrase to fit the score.
No central model/core edits or persistent services.

anchor_representation.instructions: Choose the most useful faithful representation for this bounded source recovery. This is a workflow decision, not acoustic or historical proof.

criteria.full_motifs_and_distinct_score_anchors: Preserve both complete written motifs and their starts/ends. Register first Tipcha G4 and final Etnachta A4 as independently identifiable score positions with a major-second interval, while retaining the terminal-unison fact. Decode four tracks for metadata/candidate contours, but claim exact audio agreement only where independently supported.
criteria.terminal_pair_only: Preserve only the final notes A4 and A4 as the two accent landmarks, report unison, and defer all other notated contour and audio examination.
criteria.full_audio_syllable_transcription_before: Defer reporting the source-written anchor interval until an independent complete syllable-to-time transcription and acoustic octave audit is available for all four clips.
